purpose: **LAYERS Index** — Tracks all layer definition files under the top-level LAYERS/ folder. Dynamically populated via repo scan of subfolders containing {name}.md files. Each layer .md defines its own UI rules, routing logic, and notes.
notes: Self-discovering via repo scan (GitHub API contents on testing branch). Boot layer is ONLY mandatory for initial cold-start boot. Once booted, control hands off to the dev layer by default for ongoing operation and development. Use /layer casual, /layer roleplay etc. to switch. SHA intentionally omitted from all index entries — local runtime fetches fresh SHA from GitHub API during pulls to avoid churn/mismatches on index updates. Extra files (e.g. __init__.py, chaos_music.py, suno/ in music) exist in some subfolders but are not part of the core layer definition index. Fallback on missing layer = /dev.
